gripOrHq.title: Phone Freak
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put 3 from the bank on Phone Freak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Nomad Allies
gripOrHq.rulesText:
A, [1]: Remove a tag, at no cost.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Junkyard BBS
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: Phone Freak
rig.rulesText: Put 3 from the bank on Phone Freak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

ice.title: Fatal Attractor
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

ice.title: Nerve Labyrinth
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Setup!
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Manhunt
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.
